CHOCOLATE SENSORY WORKSHOP – CUSCUN GUATAPÉ

75–90 MINUTES

Discover chocolate through all five senses.

Experience an immersive, hands-on journey where you'll explore cacao from its origin to your own handcrafted chocolate bar. Learn its fascinating history, discover traditional techniques, taste every stage of the transformation, and create unforgettable memories in the heart of Guatapé.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

🌱 Discover Cacao

🔥 Traditional Chocolate Making

-Open a mazorca cacao 
-Bean selection
-Roasting
-Traditional stone grinding
-Prepare authentic cacao liquor

☕ Prepare an Ancient Cacao Drink

👨‍🍳 Create Your Own Chocolate

English workshops require 24-hour advance reservation.

Minimum 2 people.
